answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because walnut only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, timber is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any terrace approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
